in_marathi.name: Deenabandhu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Friend of the Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deenabandhu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is a friend or helper to the gods. The name Deenabandhu is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'deena' meaning 'gods' and 'bandhu' meaning 'friend' or 'helper'.
